title: 基礎佇列操作
question:
佇列（queue）是「先進先出」：就像排隊買飲料，先排的人先買到。
請用 queue 存整數，支援三種指令：
1 x：x 排到最後面（push）
2：最前面的離開（pop）；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
3：輸出最前面的數字（front）；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
第一行輸入 N，接下來輸入 N 個指令。每個要輸出的結果各輸出一行。

test_case.note: 先排的 10 先離開，所以第二次 front 是 20

en.title: Basic Queue Operations
en.question:
A queue is "first in, first out", like a line for drinks: the first person in line buys first.
Use a queue of whole numbers with three commands:
1 x: x joins the back of the line (push)
2: the front one leaves (pop). If it is empty, output Empty!
3: output the front number (front). If it is empty, output Empty!
First input N, then N commands. Output each result on its own line.

test_case.note: 10 came first and leaves first, so the second front is 20
